## E2 — Competitive teardown, Chapter Seven continued, low shoulders, railroad crossings, pedestrians, school zones, school buses and bicyclists

No competitive teardown was performed for this section and no rival product is named or priced here, because no upstream competitive intelligence pointer exists for Vermont and guessing a competitor's structure, pedagogy or practice depth would be fictional research. What a future teardown must cover is recorded as a scoped disposition: at least two named and priced players, their module structure and sequencing, teaching style, practice format and difficulty calibration, reviewer praise to adopt and complaints to beat, and their coverage of this section's high-yield rules. Until that recon exists, the section's own ranked high-yield list in part C is the only coverage benchmark asserted.

corpus_stability.reason: The Vermont Driver's Manual is a single pinned edition (Vermont Driver’s Manual 2025; VN-007 07/2024 MTC) revised no more than once a year by the issuer; no faster-changing corpus feeds this section.
